title: Trastuzumab–HER2 complex (Cho et al., Nature 2003)
text: Crystal structure PDB 1N8Z shows trastuzumab (Herceptin) Fab bound to the extracellular region of HER2. The epitope lies on domain IV, membrane-proximal, and is distinct from the pertuzumab epitope on domain II. Nature 421:756-760 (2003), PMID 12610673. https://doi.org/10.1038/nature01392

title: Trastuzumab epitope diagram
text: Figure caption: trastuzumab Fab contacts HER2 domain IV; not the pertuzumab domain II site.
caption: Schematic of trastuzumab Fab contacting domain IV of HER2; epitope is membrane-proximal, distinct from pertuzumab domain II.

title: 1N8Z residue map (local SVG renderer)
text: Residue-level 2D snapshot highlighting HER2 positions often discussed for trastuzumab domain IV contacts, including residues near 557-593.

title: Pertuzumab binds HER2 domain II (Franklin et al., Cancer Cell 2004)
text: Pertuzumab (2C4) binds HER2 domain II and blocks dimerization. PDB 1S78. This epitope does not coincide with trastuzumab's domain IV site on 1N8Z. PMID 15093539. https://doi.org/10.1016/S1535-6108(04)00083-2

title: Prefusion RSV F with D25 (McLellan et al., Science 2013)
text: PDB 4JHW is RSV prefusion F bound to neutralizing antibody D25 at antigenic site Ø on the trimer apex. Site Ø is largely absent on postfusion F. Science 340:1113-1117 (2013), PMID 23618766. https://doi.org/10.1126/science.1234914

title: D25 / RSV F site Ø diagram
text: Figure caption: D25 binds the prefusion RSV F apex (site Ø), not the palivizumab antigenic site II.
caption: Prefusion RSV F with neutralizing antibody D25 bound at the apex site Ø.

title: 4JHW residue map
text: Local residue map for RSV F chain highlighting site Ø positions discussed for D25, including F:196-201.

title: Motavizumab / palivizumab antigenic site II on RSV F
text: Palivizumab and motavizumab target antigenic site II on RSV F, structurally distinct from the prefusion-specific site Ø occupied by D25 in 4JHW. Site II remains available on postfusion F.

title: VRC01 CD4-binding site (Zhou et al., Science 2010)
text: PDB 3NGB shows VRC01 bound to HIV-1 gp120. VRC01 is a CD4-binding-site broadly neutralizing antibody. Science 329:811-817 (2010), PMID 20616231. https://doi.org/10.1126/science.1192819

title: VRC01 CD4bs diagram
text: Figure caption: VRC01 engages the CD4-binding site on gp120; epitope overlaps the CD4 contact surface more than the b12 loop-focused footprint.
caption: VRC01 CD4-binding-site antibody contacting gp120.

title: 3NGB residue map
text: Residue snapshot highlighting gp120 CD4bs positions 365, 368, 371 often contacted by VRC01-class antibodies.

title: b12–gp120 complex (Zhou et al., Nature 2007)
text: PDB 2NY7 is broadly neutralizing antibody b12 bound to HIV-1 gp120. b12 also targets the CD4-binding site but with a different angle and loop emphasis than VRC01. Nature 445:732-737 (2007), PMID 17237795. https://doi.org/10.1038/nature05580

title: 2NY7 residue map
text: Local residue map for b12 on gp120, highlighting CD4bs residues 365 and 368 shared with other CD4bs antibodies.

title: CR3022–SARS-CoV-2 RBD (Yuan et al., Science 2020)
text: PDB 6W41: CR3022 binds a highly conserved cryptic epitope on SARS-CoV-2 RBD that does not overlap the ACE2 binding surface. Science 368:630-633 (2020), PMID 32245784. https://doi.org/10.1126/science.abb7269

title: CR3022 cryptic RBD epitope
text: Figure caption: CR3022 epitope is cryptic and ACE2-distal; class 1 RBD antibodies that block ACE2 occupy a different face.
caption: CR3022 binds a cryptic RBD epitope distal from ACE2.

title: 6W41 residue map
text: Residue snapshot for CR3022 cryptic epitope including RBD 369, 377, 408.

title: CB6 / etesevimab on SARS-CoV-2 RBD (PDB 7C01)
text: CB6 (etesevimab) binds the ACE2-overlapping face of SARS-CoV-2 RBD (PDB 7C01), a different surface from the CR3022 cryptic epitope in 6W41. Shi et al., Nature 2020, PMID 32454512.

title: D1.3–lysozyme (Bhat et al., Nature 1994; PDB 1VFB)
text: PDB 1VFB is the Fv D1.3 complex with hen egg-white lysozyme, a classic discontinuous epitope including HEL residues around 18-27 and 116-129. PMID 8072534.

title: D1.3 HEL epitope diagram
text: Figure caption: D1.3 contacts a contiguous HEL surface distinct from HyHEL-10's epitope on the same antigen.
caption: Classic HEL epitope recognized by D1.3.

title: 1VFB residue map
text: HEL residue map highlighting D1.3 contact residues 18, 24, 117.

title: HyHEL-10 on lysozyme (PDB 1C08 / 3HFM family)
text: HyHEL-10 binds hen egg-white lysozyme at an epitope centered near the active-site cleft, overlapping only partially with D1.3. Different HEL antibodies can therefore share antigen without sharing the same residue set.

title: PGT121 on HIV Env (PDB 4LSP / related)
text: PGT121-class antibodies recognize a glycan-dependent N332 supersite on HIV Env, not the CD4-binding site used by VRC01 (3NGB) or b12 (2NY7). Julien et al., Science 2013, PMID 23539182.

title: FrameContact same-antigen predicted overlap (development diagnostic)
text: On the ASEP joint same-antigen predicted-overlap five-seed development-validation aggregate, true epitope Jaccard is 0.0566 while a0 predicted top-k Jaccard mean is 0.484 and hotspot excess mean is 0.428. Claim boundary: this did not select a model and is not an official-test or SOTA result. Source receipt: FRAMECONTACT_ASEP_JOINT_SAME_ANTIGEN_PREDICTED_OVERLAP_AGGREGATE.json.

title: SAbDab as antibody structure catalogue
text: SAbDab collects antibody structures from the PDB with IMGT numbering and annotated antigens. It is a metadata index, not a substitute for residue-level epitope identity between two complexes.

title: 1N8Z child: domain IV epitope
text: Child chunk: trastuzumab epitope on HER2 domain IV in PDB 1N8Z is membrane-proximal and does not match pertuzumab domain II.

title: Intact IgG b12 (PDB 1HZH; Saphire et al., Science 2001)
text: PDB 1HZH is the crystal structure of intact human IgG1 b12, a CD4-binding-site HIV neutralizing antibody. This is the antibody molecule, not the gp120 complex (that complex is 2NY7). PMID 11408620. https://doi.org/10.1126/science.1061692

title: Intact b12 IgG schematic (1HZH)
text: Figure caption: intact b12 IgG from PDB 1HZH; not the gp120-bound complex 2NY7.
caption: Schematic of intact human IgG b12 (PDB 1HZH), distinct from the 2NY7 gp120 complex.

title: CR9114 on influenza HA (PDB 4FQI; Dreyfus et al., Science 2012)
text: PDB 4FQI shows broadly neutralizing antibody CR9114 bound to influenza H5 hemagglutinin at the stem. CR9114 is not an RSV F site Ø antibody and does not share the 4JHW D25 epitope. PMID 22878502. https://doi.org/10.1126/science.1222908

title: CR9114 HA stem diagram
text: Figure caption: CR9114 binds the influenza HA stem, a different antigen from RSV F 4JHW.
caption: CR9114 contacts the influenza HA stem epitope in PDB 4FQI.

title: 4FQI residue map
text: Local HA residue map highlighting stem positions discussed for CR9114, including HA2 18-21.
